title: Registration form (UI contract between participant and frontend)
description: Accessible names, roles and element ids the frontend renders; component, acceptance and end-to-end tests locate elements only through these. Texts are English. The frontend calls only GET /api/form-config and POST /api/registrations on its own origin (AR-01).

configLoadError.text: The registration form could not be loaded. Please try again later.

typeChooser.name: Registration type
typeChooser.initial: none selected; no fields, options, consents or submit button are shown until a type is chosen

fields.rule: exactly the fields of the chosen type are rendered as textboxes with these labels and name attributes; values typed into firstName, lastName and email are kept when the type changes

options.rule: one fieldset (role group) per category in this order, legend as above; each option of the form configuration whose availableTo contains the chosen type is a checkbox labelled with the option name and value = option id; a group with no such option is not rendered; all unchecked initially

consents.rule: one checkbox per consent of the form configuration, labelled with its text, value = consent id, never preselected (BR-05)

testMode.checkbox: I am not a robot (test mode)

production.widget: Google reCAPTCHA v2 checkbox rendered into the element with id 'recaptcha' using captchaSiteKey; reset after every failed submission

fieldErrors.rule: an error for field X is the text of the element with id 'X-error', placed directly after the control or group of X; the control has aria-invalid='true' and aria-describedby='X-error'

clientMessages.captcha: Please confirm that you are not a robot.

fieldErrors.client: on submit the frontend validates required fields (trimmed), the email format, maximum lengths, mandatory consents and the captcha; if any fails it shows the errors and sends no request (AC-004-03)
fieldErrors.server: on HTTP 400 every entry of errors[] is shown at its field id with the backend's message; the entered values remain; no confirmation (AC-004-02)

generalError.text: The registration could not be completed. Please try again later.
generalError.when: any response other than 201 or 400, or a network failure; no technical details; the form stays (AC-004-04)

confirmation.text: Thank you, <firstName> <lastName>. Your registration has been received.

selectedOptions.name: Selected options
selectedOptions.items: display names of the selected options; the text 'No options selected.' instead of the list when none

confirmation.when: only after HTTP 201; the form is no longer rendered (AC-004-01, BR-06)
